patterns.note: Full-width sections with generous vertical padding, often featuring a central content block or a multi-column grid for features and testimonials.
Large, friendly sans-serif headings are paired with a more standard, readable sans-serif for body text, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels for section introductions or feature titles.

Consistent use of a soft, light background (off-white/beige) alternating with white for content sections, contrasted with a dark teal/blue for the sticky header and some background elements, and a vibrant coral/red for CTAs.
The main navigation bar is initially transparent over the hero, then becomes sticky and gains a solid dark background color as the user scrolls down the page.
The hero section features a full-bleed video background with overlaid text, which scrolls up normally as the user navigates the page.
Sections are clearly delineated by subtle background color changes and large, descriptive headings, often featuring grids of images and short text blocks to illustrate product benefits or use cases.

technique_notes: The site employs a custom, smooth scrolling experience, likely powered by locomotive-scroll, which subtly enhances the flow between sections.

The main navigation bar is initially transparent and positioned over a full-bleed video hero, then transitions to a fixed position at the top of the viewport with a solid background color as the user scrolls down.
Content sections are structured using flexible grids to display product features, testimonials, and use cases, often combining engaging imagery with concise text descriptions.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, friendly sans-serif headings (approx. 3-4x body text) with a clean, readable sans-serif for body copy and smaller, uppercase labels for feature titles.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (approx. 8-12px) on buttons, image cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable spacing within content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site effectively uses a warm, inviting visual language with a focus on children's interaction and safety, making a potentially complex AI product feel approachable and beneficial. The integration of real-world imagery of children with the product is central to its appeal, moving beyond generic tech aesthetics.
